## Goal

When free space drops past a threshold or on request, re-measure the dirty objects within budget and attribute the volume delta to measured objects, with the unexplained remainder stated.

- Measured attribution in explain_growth

## Acceptance Criteria

- `AC-TASK-661-01` — Dirty objects from the change journal are re-measured within the review budgets; explain_growth reports per-object deltas from the last measured size, the attributed total, the unexplained remainder (System Data, purgeable space, snapshots, out of scope) and journal gaps.
- `AC-TASK-661-02` — A fixture with growth in two objects and outside the scope attributes the in-scope delta within 5% and reports the rest as unexplained.
